第376章 血祭 二合一求月票（第1页）
连绵山岭之间，终年刮着一股灰黑色怪风。
这种怪风并不算强，却能阻隔神识。普通筑基修士若是深入其中，神识最多只能放出百余丈。
黑风岭深处，一座不起眼的荒山附近，隐藏着一条狭长裂谷。
裂谷两侧怪石林立，地面寸草不生。
关羽恼怒地紧皱双眉，瞪向聂芸娘。偏偏芸娘置之不理，别过脸去。
吴熙笑了笑，从来都没有听过这么报答人家恩情的人，这人看上去年龄不大，却是一条好汉子，要是能为自己所用，那就太好了。
没想到，我来到大师姐的千仪峰时，也是山门紧闭，看来大师姐也是在闭关中，难道也是要突破了？
“到那换人为主，尽量不要动手，因为对面人多……”我现在知道所以人都很气愤，所以特意嘱咐了一句。
睡眼惺忪的管家将府门拉开了一条细缝，好奇地打量着这位不速之客。
王彦想从染仙嘴里问出事情始末，可是见她一副醋意大发，泫然欲滴，委屈至极的模样后，王彦深知想要问话，就得先把她二人摆平才行。
蝴蝶一个劲的点头，这个时候她已经失去了自己的判断，虽然以前的经历丰富，但是就像钟明亮说的那样，她好像在吴熙的家里迷失了自己，以前的那个她已、再也找不回来了。
林音有些莫名其妙，答道：“谢师太关心，晚辈没事。”他努力思索，却全然不记得昨天后半夜发生了什么，也不知道自己为何一觉睡到黄昏。
晚上是更大一碗的肉粥，吃饱饭后一夜无话。第二天早晨醒时，林音更觉全身疼痛，胸口淤血似堵住嗓子，十分难受。咬牙爬起，在屋外寻了个角落，立刻弯腰大吐，吐出的尽是发黑的淤血。
林容深不再看向我和简庭，牵着米莉从我们面前走了过去，可还没到达屏风前，里面突然传来老人的笑声。
我立马跑过去，这下还真有点吃惊了，这玩意居然完全是水泥做成的，这要是一盖上去，跟水泥地结合起来，还真一点都看不出漏洞，这些家伙也玩得太高科技了点吧？
他们都是血缘亲密的一家人，而她不是，她努力的融入这个家里，让她变成这个家的一份子，过去她一直适应的很好，但是现在，她好像不确定了。
新娘一听这话顿时就懵了，她没有想到孙一凡背后能牵扯出这么个刘景山。

卧槽，怎么又是那里，之前听说那血蛇也是从那里被龙哥派人寻过来的，而这种己乌居然又在那个地方。
“甜甜，你就这么忍心看着你的父亲身败名裂？不管他曾经做过什么，他始终是你的父亲，这个世界上最爱你的人……”话到最后，苏美有些苦口婆心了。
旁边于婶努力的和她说话，她像是没听见一般。穿白大褂的医生在离她一米以外的地方，稍稍靠近她一点她的身体就会忍不住颤抖。
然而，就在这时，吕熙宁停下了脚步，伸手拉住了她缓慢前行的身子。
可她和萧世清之间，除了斩不断的血缘之外，还有什么情义可言吗？
临港市距离香港只是隔着一条江，走私相当猖獗。可以说，洛江市就是临港市的前沿阵地了，而南城区更是洛江市的重中之重，就算是中环区的许爷，也要给苏家四兄弟几分薄面。

Chapter 376 Blood Sacrifice Two-in-One Please vote for me (page 1)
Between the rolling mountains, a strange gray-black wind blows all year round.
This strange wind is not very strong, but it can block spiritual consciousness. If an ordinary foundation-building monk goes deep into it, his spiritual consciousness can only be released for more than a hundred feet at most.
Deep in the Black Wind Ridge, near an inconspicuous barren mountain, there is a long and narrow rift valley hidden.
There are many strange rocks on both sides of the rift valley, and the ground is barren of grass.
Guan Yu frowned in anger and glared at Nie Yunniang. However, Yun Niang ignored him and turned away.
Wu Xi smiled. He had never heard of someone repaying others' kindness in this way. This man looked young, but he was a good man. It would be great if he could be used by him.
Unexpectedly, when I came to Senior Sister’s Qianyi Peak, the mountain gate was also closed. It seemed that Senior Sister was also in retreat. Could it be that she was about to break through?
"When you get there, change the main person, and try not to do anything, because there are many people on the other side..." I now know that everyone is very angry, so I specifically gave this instruction.
The sleepy butler opened the door to the house a small crack and looked at the uninvited guest curiously.
Wang Yan wanted to ask Ranxian the whole story, but after seeing her jealous, lustful, and extremely aggrieved look, Wang Yan knew that before he could ask questions, he had to settle the two of her down first.
Butterfly nodded vigorously. At this time, she had lost her judgment. Although she had rich experiences in the past, just like Zhong Mingliang said, she seemed to have lost herself in Wu Xi's home. She could never find the person she was before.
Lin Yin was a little confused and replied: "Thank you for your concern, junior. I'm fine." He thought hard, but he couldn't remember what happened in the second half of the night yesterday, and he didn't know why he slept until dusk.
In the evening, there was a bigger bowl of meat porridge. After a full meal, I was speechless all night. When Lin Yin woke up the next morning, he felt pain all over his body. The congestion in his chest seemed to be blocking his throat, which was very uncomfortable. Gritting his teeth, he climbed up and found a corner outside the house. He immediately bent over and vomited, and all he vomited was black bruises.
Lin Rongshen stopped looking at me and Jian Ting, and led Milly past us. But before he reached the screen, the old man's laughter suddenly came from inside.
I ran over immediately, and I was a little surprised now. This thing was actually made entirely of cement. If it were covered and combined with the cement floor, there would really be no loopholes at all. These guys are too high-tech, right?
They were all a family with close blood ties, but she was not. She worked hard to integrate into the family and become a part of the family. She had always adapted well in the past, but now, she seemed unsure.
The bride was stunned when she heard this. She didn't expect that Liu Jingshan could be involved behind Sun Yifan.
Damn it, where is it again? I heard that the blood snake was also sent by Brother Long to find it from there, but this kind of snake is actually in that place again.
"Tiantian, can you bear to see your father ruined? No matter what he has done, he will always be your father, the person who loves you most in the world..." At the end of her words, Su Mei spoke bitterly.
Aunt Yu next to her tried hard to talk to her, but she seemed not to hear her. The doctor in a white coat was one meter away from her. If he got even a little closer to her, her body could not help but tremble.
However, at this moment, Lu Xining stopped and reached out to hold her slowly moving body.
But apart from the unbroken blood relationship, is there any friendship between her and Xiao Shiqing?
Lingang City is only across a river from Hong Kong, and smuggling is quite rampant. It can be said, Luojiang City is the front line of Lingang City, and Nancheng District is the top priority of Luojiang City. Even Mr. Xu from Zhonghuan District has to give some favor to the four brothers of the Su family.
